title: Avoid quadratic UTF-8 recounts during streamed text deltas
outcome: ui/src/live-updates.ts recomputes the UTF-8 byte length of the entire accumulated message for every textDelta when validating textStartByte. Long streamed replies therefore perform O(n^2) encoding work on the SSE hot path.
acceptance: Track or derive the current UTF-8 byte offset incrementally without rescanning the full accumulated prefix on each delta. Preserve mismatch/resync behavior and add multibyte plus long-stream regression coverage demonstrating linear work.
